title: The 'Inbox Zero' Method That Actually Takes Less Than 30 Minutes
script: Inbox Zero isn't about replying to everything. It's about deciding — for every single email — what action it requires. Four options: delete it, delegate it, respond to it, or defer it. That's it. The two-minute rule applies: if you can reply in two minutes, do it now. If not, defer it to a task manager or a dedicated reply folder. The goal isn't to empty your inbox — it's to empty your brain. When your inbox is chaos, your mind is chaos. Clear one, you clear the other.
